Man Accused of Blackmailing Minor with Explicit Videos in Muzaffarpur

In Muzaffarpur, a 17-year-old minor has accused a man of promising marriage, creating explicit videos, and extorting ₹70,000. The victim alleges the accused pressured her into sexual acts under the guise of deleting the videos, calling her to a hotel in Maripur. Police have registered a case against a father and son under the POCSO Act.
